items.question: What are your contact hours?
items.answer: We are available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time. Messages received outside those hours are answered on the next business day.

items.question: How quickly do you respond?
items.answer: We respond within one business day to messages and strategy intake submissions.

items.question: What is the difference between Send a message, Book a strategy conversation, and a free audit?
items.answer: Send a message is for general questions. Book a strategy conversation is a short intake so we can prep before we talk. A free audit is a structured catalog and advertising review on its own dedicated page.

items.question: Is my account information confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Catalog, advertising, and account details you share are treated as confidential and used only to respond to your inquiry.

items.question: What should I include in a message?
items.answer: Share your marketplace, roughly what you sell, and the main challenge — for example wasted ad spend, listing conversion, or multi-marketplace expansion. Links to your storefront help when available.
